column1: # Prewarm seed list (shipped in the app, next to shader_map.tsv). Rows: S<TAB>shader key<TAB>stage / R<TAB>render pipeline key (pso_skey hex) / C<TAB>compute shader key / M<TAB>task shader key or -<TAB>native task / mesh pipeline key (pso_skey hex: the mesh shader in the vertex place).

# Recorded on a MacBook Pro M3 Pro (macOS 27.2) on v131072, chain adec7d81d970, with no prewarm lists present (everything built on the spot): boot, the title and its movie, a new game and the opening, Link's house, Kokiri Forest, a save load.

# The last five C rows were added by hand: compute pipelines built at Saria's greeting on a first start (Deku Scrub, Business Scrub, Deku Baba), found on an M4 MacBook Air (PR 1488); without a bundled pipeline archive (iOS) they are built there otherwise.

# The M rows at the end: native task / mesh pipelines built at their first draw, recorded on v131072 in Kokiri Forest, Hyrule Field, Castle Town and Hyrule Castle (PR 1368, its comments and PR 1488; 123 after duplicates).

# The last 41 M rows: 39 model pipelines behind the task shader a5288d0a6c4971fd_b and 2 foliage pipelines without one, recorded in later play (Death Mountain Trail among it); without them a cold first start on a Death Mountain Trail save built 9-10 of them at their first draw, up to 1.7 s each.

# The last 4,959 rows (3,193 S, 1,579 R, 187 C), from an iPad Pro (M5) and a Mac on v131072: the rows of the iPad's own pso_user.tsv lists after hours of play that were not here, then the rows recorded on the Mac on first looks at new places with the iPad's lists as the device list (the forest bridge with Saria's farewell, Hyrule Field, the Lost Woods, Kokiri Forest). On iOS each render pipeline no list names is built at its first draw, 0.1-0.9 s each on the iPad.
